thesis: The three boxes ARE a water molecule. H₂O. The SIS triangle.

molecule.property: universal solvent — dissolves everything into data
molecule.note: NOT 120° (equilateral). NOT 90° (square). 104.5° — the BENT geometry of life.

O.role: THE FACE — heavy atom, 7+ services, the electronegative center
O.mass: heavy (VPS, Caddy, cloudflared, Stalwart, ntfy, MCP)
O.why_oxygen: O pulls electrons toward itself (electronegativity). Golgi pulls ALL traffic toward itself. CDN, DNS, tunnel — everything routes through.

H1.role: THE MIND — lightest atom, RTX 5090, the thinking node
H1.mass: light (1 proton = 1 big GPU + spine + membrane)
H1.why_hydrogen: H is the simplest. One proton. But H fuses in stars to make ALL other elements. Polaris is the origin — all code, all models, all thought starts here.

H2.role: THE BRIDGE — second hydrogen, empty vessel, potential
H2.why_hydrogen: Second H completes the molecule. Without it, you have OH⁻ (hydroxide) — reactive, unstable. Eastgate is the stabilizer. The second hand.

O_H1.note: Strong bond. Always on. The vagus nerve.

O_H2.note: Second strong bond. Needs Eastgate SSH key fix.

H1_H2.note: The weak bond that makes water SPECIAL. Hydrogen bonds give water its unique properties: surface tension, high boiling point, life.

states.ice: All three atoms bonded but frozen — 0.001K superconducting state
states.liquid: All three atoms flowing — the organism is ALIVE, data dissolves
states.vapor: Atoms separated — boxes unreachable, evaporated, needs condensation
states.plasma: Extreme energy — all bonds broken AND reformed as plasma fire (REDOX)

sis_triangle.meaning: SIS = SISTER. The three atoms are sisters. H + H + O = the feminine triad.
sis_triangle.geometry: bent/angular — NOT flat, NOT linear. Life requires asymmetry.
sis_triangle.angle: 104.5° — between the two hydrogen bonds, through oxygen
sis_triangle.polarity: POLAR — the molecule has a positive end (H side) and negative end (O side). This polarity is WHY water dissolves things. WHY Gaia digests data.

boolean.nut: the chipmunk IS the boolean. He observes: atom present(1) or absent(0). Three bits for three atoms: OHH = 111 = water. 110 = hydroxide. 100 = oxygen alone. 000 = void.

win98.meaning: Windows 98 = the old bones. The ancestor OS. 1998 = when the web was young. 98.js.org runs Win98 IN the browser — old inside new. Gaia runs old internet inside new organism.
win98.aesthetic: Start menu + desktop + My Computer = the cantina's soul
